definitions.explanation: Describes doing or saying something without showing emotion, in a detached or composed manner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{淡々|たんたん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
{淡々|たんたん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。
examples.english: To handle work calmly and steadily.

examples.japanese: {淡々|たんたん}とした⟦{口調|くちょう}→口調：11803_kuchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: She spoke in a dispassionate tone.

notes:
{淡々|たんたん} conveys emotional detachment and composure. Can be positive (professional calm), neutral, or slightly cold depending on context.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Adverb: {淡々|たんたん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + verb
- Na-adjective: {淡々|たんたん}とした + noun
- Taru-adjective: {淡々|たんたん}たる + noun (formal/literary)
- {淡々|たんたん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak dispassionately
- {淡々|たんたん}とした⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: matter-of-fact attitude
- {淡々|たんたん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to work steadily without fuss
- {淡々|たんたん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to live each day calmly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧: calm, composed (more about rational thinking)
- ⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧: calm, settled (warmer tone)
- ⟦{無表情|むひょうじょう}→無表情：23140_muhyoujou⟧: expressionless (more negative)
